hebrewText: וְ֭/הָיִיתָ כְּ/שֹׁכֵ֣ב בְּ/לֶב יָ֑ם וּ֝/כְ/שֹׁכֵ֗ב בְּ/רֹ֣אשׁ חִבֵּֽל

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

tokens.bdb: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
tokens.kjv: [phrase] care for, comfortably, consent, [idiom] considered, courag(-eous), friend(-ly), ((broken-), (hard-), (merry-), (stiff-), (stout-), double) heart(-ed), [idiom] heed, [idiom] I, kindly, midst, mind(-ed), [idiom] regard(-ed), [idiom] themselves, [idiom] unawares, understanding, [idiom] well, willingly, wisdom.
tokens.enLiteralWord: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings
tokens.explanation: lev — coração, mente, vontade, centro da vida interior
tokens.explanationEn: the heart; also used  very widely for the feelings

tokens.bdb: a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: yam — mar, lago, oceano, ocidente (o mar fica a oeste)
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically

tokens.bdb: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

tokens.bdb: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
tokens.kjv: band, beginning, captain, chapiter, chief(-est place, man, things), company, end, [idiom] every (man), excellent, first, forefront, (be-)head, height, (on) high(-est part, (priest)), [idiom] lead, [idiom] poor, principal, ruler, sum, top.
